svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cut 140 x 220 mm from 3 mm sheet; round the corners 5 mm.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: U-bolt holes: two pairs of 8.5 mm holes, 66 mm apart, centred

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: across the plate, 10 mm in from the top and bottom edges.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Box holes: hold the controller box centred on the plate and

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: drill through its mounting lugs (four 4.5 mm holes).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: the plate's back touches the mast; two 2 in U-bolts go

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: round the mast and through the plate with nyloc nuts; the box

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: screws to the plate's front with M4 screws.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The box sits 3 mm off the mast, its base 1.1 m above the ground.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: the plate does not turn on the mast with the nuts tight.
